text.description_html:
Standard Track for LCN 4111T Closer, LCN-4110T-3038

This is the new style replacement track for LCN 4111T Track Closer (LCN Super Smoothee) Surface Mount Track Arm Closer. Track does not have the eight (8) small screw holes that were used for the old style Hold Open Clip and/or Stop Cushion.

Also available other LCN Door Closer Parts

Standard, non hold-open, non-handed track. Will accept 4110T-3054 Hold Open Clip and/or 4110T-169 Stop Bumper assembly.

Total track length is 22-1/2" and has a Aluminum finish. Package includes necessary track mounting screw hardware.

*Sold Individually
